Walk around the town
A small weekend trip
The scenery of an old bookstore that remains along the river.
Memo for a walk
From the station to the river, fifteen minutes slowly.
When I walked through the town after the rain, I saw a light in the window of an old bookstore. The owner prepared warm tea and listened to the story of the trip. On the way back, I crossed the bridge along the river. The evening sky was reflected on the quiet water. There is a small coffee shop across the bridge. I spread the map at the window seat and decided on the next way to walk. If you walk without rushing, there will be new discoveries in your usual town.
